notes.title: TJ major update
notes.content:
What's in this update:
* Starting through Steam crash for some players now should be fixed.
* No more loading times on re-spawn.
* Overall much better fps and game performance.
* Uplifted graphics.
* Numerous bugs fixed.

notes.title: Tomato Jones 2 has been released on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello guys,
Finally, TJ2 is up on Steam. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/625940/Tomato_Jones_2/

The sequel is harder than the original and we strongly recommend to try Tomato Jones first!

notes.title: Game crash fix.
notes.content:
Hello guys.
The issue with the crash that some people have reported is connected with the newest Steam client update.
Meanwhile you should be able to start the game with no crashes in fullscreen mode if do the following:
- go to /system folder of the game and start directly TomatoJones.exe file.
That should fix the problem, just for now you must start the game directly from TomatoJones.exe and NOT by its icon.

notes.title: Loading times cut in half!
notes.content:
I hear you guys, thank you for your feedback!
Now loading times should be cut at least in half and you can enjoy the game at faster pace.
Sky boxes and new levels are coming soon.
